classification.question_topic: Asking if others have experienced a recurring liminal-space dream of an endless, empty suburban neighborhood with a stalking presence and an uncrossable/growing fence boundary.

meta.final_emotion: wake up terrified (especially as a kid)

qualities.raw_description: walking down a street at night with a feeling of unease; all of the houses look the exact same; none of the houses have lights on, or cars in the driveway, and there are no people around; run for what feels like hours through a dead, endless neighborhood

position.relative_to: off the street / within the neighborhood

qualities.raw_description: run into one of the backyards thinking I could hop a wooden fence; as I get my hands on the top the fence it shoots up higher, knocking me to the ground; it grows taller yet again; it's now about 50 feet tall

connections.qualities: runs from street through neighborhood into a backyard to try to hop a fence

boundaries.description: wooden fence that 'shoots up higher' when grabbed/climbed; knocks dreamer down; eventually 'about 50 feet tall'

interactions.description: Dream starts with walking down a street at night; dreamer realizes something is stalking them (cannot make out what it is); runs for what feels like hours; tries to scream for help but no noise escapes lungs.

entities_involved.description: something stalking/pursuing; when young associated it with a werewolf but 'wasn't exactly that'; later appears as glowing red eyes in darkness with a low gutteral sound

interactions.description: Dreamer runs into a backyard to hop a wooden fence; each time they grab/scramble up it grows taller and knocks them to the ground; hears pursuer getting closer; looks up and fence is ~50 feet tall; hears low gutteral sound; turns to see a pair of glowing red eyes staring from darkness; wakes up just before being attacked.

entities_involved.description: pair of glowing red eyes in the darkness; low gutteral sound; closes in as dreamer is blocked by fence

extraction.extraction_notes: Image appears to be a real aerial photo of uniform suburban houses used as a visual reference (not a hand-drawn map). Spatial layout is described narratively: street → backyard → wooden fence that becomes an uncrossable boundary by increasing height.
